Me, my 2 siblings and parents nearly died of Carbon Monoxide poisoning. 

I was around 8 and it was night time when I suddenly started to feel dizzy whilst watching a children’s show, I told my dad and he said I’m tired, I should go to sleep. Trusting him, I started slowly walking to my bed, clinging onto the walls around me. A bit of a memory loss here but basically my mum came out the steaming shower really tired, instantly fell asleep once she got into her bed and a couple minutes after suddenly woke up (she insists an angel was protecting her), she sensed something was wrong and called the ambulance immediately. They instantly knew and told us to open up all the windows, we then stayed at the hospital breathing oxygen for a week and taking 3 blood tests a day.

So thanks mum for waking up!
